description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Eos' task in a media playback system, specifically testing the behavior of setting end-of-stream (EOS) in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It uses Google Test framework to verify different scenarios such as failure to find stream, successful EOS setting, handling of underflow conditions, and interactions with mock objects.

classes.name: EosTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the Eos task in various scenarios.

methods.name: shouldFailWhenStreamIsNotFound
methods.description: Test case where the stream info is not present, expecting the EOS task to handle missing stream gracefully.

methods.name: shouldSetEos
methods.description: Test case where EOS is successfully set for an audio stream.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetEos
methods.description: Test case where setting EOS fails, simulating an error return from gstAppSrcEndOfStream.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndCancelAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Test case where EOS is set for audio and any ongoing audio underflow is canceled.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndSkipCancellingVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Test case where EOS is set for audio while video underflow has occurred, but no cancel is needed.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndCancelVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Test case where EOS is set for video and any ongoing video underflow is canceled.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndSkipCancellingAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Test case where EOS is set for video while audio underflow has occurred, but no cancel is needed.
